model_annotation: This Eurostat chart from 2021 presents three donut charts comparing the distribution of enterprises, employed persons, and net turnover across four economic sectors—Industry, Construction, Trade, and Other Services—based on NACE Rev. 2 classifications. The first chart, “Number of Enterprises,” shows Other Services dominating with 61% (19.0 million), followed by Trade (19%, 5.9 million), Construction (12%, 3.7 million), and Industry (8%, 2.4 million). The second chart, “Number of Persons Employed,” reveals Other Services again as the largest employer at 51% (80.2 million), followed by Industry (21%, 33.0 million), Trade (19%, 29.5 million), and Construction (9%, 13.4 million). The third chart, “Turnover,” indicates that Industry and Trade each account for 31% (9.8 trillion and 9.9 trillion respectively), with Other Services at 33% (10.6 trillion) and Construction at 6% (1.9 trillion). A legend at the bottom identifies the color coding: gold for Industry, light blue for Construction, red for Trade, and dark blue for Other Services. The charts visually emphasize the disproportionate economic weight of Other Services in terms of enterprise count and employment, while Industry, Trade, and Other Services are more evenly matched in turnover.
